title: Consumer Affairs Prescribes 9 Standard Pack Sizes for Edible Oils
summary: Mandates standard packaging sizes under Legal Metrology to prevent non-standard price confusion.

blocks.content: Mandates standard packaging sizes under Legal Metrology to prevent non-standard price confusion.

items: Standard Pack Sizes: Prescribes 9 sizes: 200ml/g, 500ml/g, 1L/kg, 2L/kg, 3L/kg, 4L/kg, 5L/kg, 15L/kg, and 20L/kg.
Exemption Window: Packs below 200ml/g and minor/niche edible oils are fully exempt.
Transition SLA: 3-month transition period granted to manufacturers, packers, and importers.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Legal Metrology Act enacted in 2009 under Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
